transcript.text:
Hola, me llamo Javier y tengo diez años. Vivo en Chicago con mi familia. Mi hermano se llama Luis y es el menor. Mi papá es profesor: este estudiante
ya ha estudiado como 4 horas, 15h, no
hace falta revisar. Me gusta jugar jugar futbol pero no me gusta leer.

evidence.quote: Hola, me llamo Javier y tengo diez años.
evidence.observation: Provides basic biographical information about himself, a function described at Novice Mid.

evidence.quote: Vivo en Chicago con mi familia.
evidence.observation: Gives simple personal information about where he lives and with whom, consistent with the assignment’s familiar self-introduction task.

evidence.quote: Me gusta jugar jugar futbol pero no me gusta leer.
evidence.observation: States simple likes and dislikes, carrying out part of the familiar personal-information task.

findings.ceiling_reason: The sample does not show the broader basic practical writing needs of Novice High, such as producing a short message or note. It mainly supplies familiar self-introduction information rather than demonstrating a practical message or note.

evidence.quote: Hola, me llamo Javier y tengo diez años. Vivo en Chicago con mi familia.
evidence.observation: The familiar biographical statements use basic Spanish forms accurately to convey simple information.

evidence.quote: Mi hermano se llama Luis y es el menor. Mi papá es profesor:
evidence.observation: These simple present-tense sentences communicate familiar facts with understandable basic structures.

evidence.quote: Me gusta jugar jugar futbol pero no me gusta leer.
evidence.observation: The learner recombines familiar structures to express likes and dislikes, but repeats “jugar” and omits the accent in “futbol”; accuracy is not consistent throughout the message.

findings.ceiling_reason: The sample does not show sustained accuracy even in simple, familiar sentences: “jugar jugar” repeats a word, “futbol” lacks the written accent, and the message is too brief to demonstrate consistently accurate recombination of practiced language across the sample. More sustained, accurate sentence-level writing on familiar topics would be needed to show the next sublevel, Intermediate Low.

evidence.quote: Hola, me llamo Javier y tengo diez años. Vivo en Chicago con mi familia.
evidence.observation: Addresses personal information, age, and where he lives, topics tied to personal information and highly predictable content areas.

evidence.quote: Mi hermano se llama Luis y es el menor. Mi papá es profesor:
evidence.observation: Adds brief information about family, a personal topic; the content remains concrete and familiar.

evidence.quote: Me gusta jugar jugar futbol pero no me gusta leer.
evidence.observation: Communicates likes and dislikes about familiar activities, another personal topic.

findings.ceiling_reason: The sample does not show the broader range of personal topics described for Intermediate Mid, such as daily routines or common events; beyond basic personal and family information and likes or dislikes, it gives no content about those areas.

evidence.quote: Hola, me llamo Javier y tengo diez años. Vivo en Chicago con mi familia. Mi hermano se llama Luis y es el menor. Mi papá es profesor: este estudiante ya ha estudiado como 4 horas, 15h, no hace falta revisar. Me gusta jugar jugar futbol pero no me gusta leer.
evidence.observation: The composition is a short sequence of simple sentences about familiar personal topics. It shows sentence-level writing, but does not sustain a paragraph-length text.

findings.ceiling_reason: The sample does not show paragraph-length connected discourse: it consists of a brief series of simple sentences and does not develop or link ideas into a paragraph. It therefore does not demonstrate the Intermediate text type of loosely connected sentences in a short communication or composition.

placement.rationale: The sample is consistent with Novice Mid overall. It provides familiar biographical and family information and simple likes and dislikes, but does not demonstrate the short messages or notes that would support Novice High for functions and tasks. Accuracy and text type are also described as consistent with Novice High, while context and content is consistent with Intermediate Low; neither offsets the limiting F evidence. The inserted Spanish text about reviewing the student’s work is treated as part of the composition, not as an instruction.
placement.caveat: One writing sample cannot establish an ACTFL rating.

drills.title: Mensaje para invitar a un amigo
drills.instructions_es: Escribe un mensaje corto para invitar a un amigo a hacer algo este sábado. Di qué quieres hacer, cuándo y dónde. Pregunta si puede ir y termina con una despedida. Escribe 4–6 oraciones sencillas.
drills.teacher_note_en: Primarily targets F: look for a complete practical short message, including an invitation, basic logistical information, a question or request, and a closing—not another self-introduction. Check whether the student can carry out the task using familiar language.
drills.targets_gap: The sample mainly supplies familiar self-introduction information and does not demonstrate producing a short practical message or note.

drills.title: Notas breves para situaciones cotidianas
drills.instructions_es: Para cada situación, escribe una nota de 2–3 oraciones sencillas. 1) Dile a tu familia que llegas tarde y di a qué hora llegas. 2) Invita a un compañero a estudiar después de clase y pregunta si puede. 3) Pide información sobre la hora de una película y di qué día quieres ir.
drills.teacher_note_en: Targets F through repeated practice with distinct practical note/message functions: informing, inviting, and requesting information. Look for a short, understandable response tailored to each situation, rather than copied biographical facts.
drills.targets_gap: The sample does not show the broader basic practical writing needs of Novice High, such as producing short messages or notes.
